CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_edit_resource(p_resource_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.resources r
    join public.workspace_members wm
      on wm.workspace_id = r.workspace_id
      and wm.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and wm.status = 'active'::public.membership_status
    join public.profiles own_profile
      on own_profile.id = wm.user_id
      and own_profile.is_active
    join public.workspaces w
      on w.id = r.workspace_id
      and w.archived_at is null
    where r.id = p_resource_id
      and r.archived_at is null
      and (
        wm.role in ('owner'::public.workspace_role, 'admin'::public.workspace_role)
        or (
          wm.role = 'manager'::public.workspace_role
          and (
            not r.is_restricted
            or r.created_by = (select auth.uid())
            or exists (
              select 1
              from public.resource_permissions rp
              where rp.workspace_id = r.workspace_id
                and rp.resource_id = r.id
                and rp.user_id = (select auth.uid())
                and rp.permission = 'edit'::public.resource_permission_level
            )
          )
        )
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ensure_workspace_operating_model()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_default_team_id uuid;
begin
  if new.status <> 'active'::public.membership_status
     or new.removed_at is not null then
    return new;
  end if;

  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended('pta:operating-model:' || new.workspace_id::text, 0)
  );

  -- A workspace viewer may remain associated with a team for visibility, but
  -- must never retain a stale operational lead role after a role downgrade.
  if new.role = 'viewer'::public.workspace_role then
    update public.team_members team_member
    set role = 'member'::public.team_member_role
    where team_member.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
      and team_member.user_id = new.user_id
      and team_member.role = 'lead'::public.team_member_role
      and team_member.removed_at is null;
  end if;

  select team.id
  into v_default_team_id
  from public.teams team
  where team.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
    and team.is_default
    and team.archived_at is null
  order by team.created_at, team.id
  limit 1;

  if v_default_team_id is null then
    insert into public.teams (
      workspace_id,
      name,
      slug,
      description,
      color,
      is_default,
      created_by
    ) values (
      new.workspace_id,
      'Operação',
      'operacao',
      'Equipe principal do workspace.',
      'blue',
      true,
      new.user_id
    )
    returning id into v_default_team_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.team_members (
    workspace_id,
    team_id,
    user_id,
    role,
    is_primary,
    added_by,
    joined_at
  ) values (
    new.workspace_id,
    v_default_team_id,
    new.user_id,
    case
      when new.role in ('owner'::public.workspace_role, 'admin'::public.workspace_role)
        then 'lead'::public.team_member_role
      else 'member'::public.team_member_role
    end,
    not exists (
      select 1
      from public.team_members existing
      where existing.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
        and existing.user_id = new.user_id
        and existing.removed_at is null
    ),
    new.user_id,
    new.joined_at
  )
  on conflict (workspace_id, team_id, user_id) do update
  set
    removed_at = null,
    removed_by = null,
    is_primary = case
      when exists (
        select 1
        from public.team_members existing
        where existing.workspace_id = excluded.workspace_id
          and existing.user_id = excluded.user_id
          and existing.team_id <> excluded.team_id
          and existing.is_primary
          and existing.removed_at is null
      ) then team_members.is_primary
      else true
    end;

  with standard_function(system_key, name, category, description, position) as (
    values
      ('marketing_head', 'Head de Marketing ou Growth', 'Liderança e estratégia', 'Define objetivos, orçamento, prioridades e decisões de alto risco.', 10),
      ('operations_lead', 'Líder de Operação ou Campanha', 'Liderança e estratégia', 'Conduz triagem, sequência, prazos, capacidade e escalonamentos.', 20),
      ('strategist', 'Estrategista', 'Liderança e estratégia', 'Consolida público, oferta, canais, hipótese e briefing.', 30),
      ('copywriter', 'Copywriter', 'Conteúdo e criação', 'Produz mensagens, anúncios, páginas e roteiros.', 100),
      ('designer', 'Designer', 'Conteúdo e criação', 'Produz peças visuais e adaptações de formato.', 110),
      ('motion_designer', 'Motion ou Vídeo', 'Conteúdo e criação', 'Produz peças animadas, edição e acabamento audiovisual.', 120),
      ('media_buyer', 'Gestor de Tráfego', 'Aquisição e conversão', 'Planeja mídia, configura campanhas, publica e otimiza.', 200),
      ('web_designer', 'Web Designer ou Desenvolvedor', 'Web, automação e dados', 'Entrega páginas, formulários, responsividade e publicação web.', 300),
      ('crm_specialist', 'CRM ou Lifecycle', 'Web, automação e dados', 'Opera e-mail, WhatsApp, automações e segmentação.', 310),
      ('content_manager', 'Conteúdo ou Social', 'Conteúdo e criação', 'Organiza calendário editorial, publicação e comunidade.', 130),
      ('data_analyst', 'Dados ou Analytics', 'Web, automação e dados', 'Valida tracking, UTMs, eventos e leitura de performance.', 320),
      ('quality_reviewer', 'QA ou Revisor', 'Qualidade e aprovação', 'Confere marca, links, tracking, formatos e critérios de aceite.', 400)
  )
  insert into public.job_functions (
    workspace_id,
    system_key,
    name,
    category,
    description,
    position,
    is_system,
    created_by
  )
  select
    new.workspace_id,
    standard_function.system_key,
    standard_function.name,
    standard_function.category,
    standard_function.description,
    standard_function.position,
    true,
    new.user_id
  from standard_function
  on conflict do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.event_health(p_override text, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_progress integer, p_overdue integer, p_critical integer, p_blocked integer, p_today date)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_override is not null then p_override
    when p_critical > 0 then 'risk'
    when p_end_date is not null and p_end_date < p_today and p_progress < 100 then 'risk'
    when p_overdue >= 3 then 'risk'
    when p_overdue > 0 or p_blocked > 0 then 'attention'
    when p_start_date is not null and p_end_date is not null
      and p_end_date > p_start_date
      and p_today between p_start_date and p_end_date
      and p_progress + 20 < least(100, greatest(0,
        round(100.0 * (p_today - p_start_date) / (p_end_date - p_start_date))::integer
      )) then 'attention'
    else 'healthy'
  end;
$function$

  select p_url is not null

    and btrim(p_url) ~ '^https://[^[:space:]/:?#@]+(?::[0-9]{1,5})?(?:[/?#][^[:space:]]*)?$'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_valid_task_attachment_type(p_extension text, p_mime_type text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case lower(p_extension)
    when 'pdf' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'application/pdf'
    when 'png' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'image/png'
    when 'jpg' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'image/jpeg'
    when 'jpeg' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'image/jpeg'
    when 'webp' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'image/webp'
    when 'docx' then lower(p_mime_type) =
      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
    when 'xlsx' then lower(p_mime_type) =
      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
    when 'csv' then lower(p_mime_type) in ('text/csv', 'application/csv')
    when 'txt' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'text/plain'
    when 'zip' then lower(p_mime_type) in (
      'application/zip',
      'application/x-zip-compressed'
    )
    when 'gif' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'image/gif'
    when 'mp3' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'audio/mpeg'
    when 'wav' then lower(p_mime_type) in ('audio/wav','audio/x-wav')
    when 'webm' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'video/webm'
    when 'mov' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'video/quicktime'
    when 'mp4' then lower(p_mime_type) = 'video/mp4'
    else false
  end;
$function$

  perform private.lock_resource_category_write(v_workspace_id, v_category_id);

        resource.resource_type,
        resource.workspace_id,

    where resource.id = p_resource_id
  )
  update public.resources resource

  from next_vector
  where resource.id = next_vector.id
    and resource.search_vector is distinct from next_vector.search_vector;
end;

 RETURNS trigger

AS $function$
declare
  v_action text;
begin
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE'
    and new.search_vector is distinct from old.search_vector
    and new.category_id is not distinct from old.category_id
    and new.resource_type is not distinct from old.resource_type
    and new.title is not distinct from old.title
    and new.description is not distinct from old.description
    and new.external_url is not distinct from old.external_url
    and new.is_restricted is not distinct from old.is_restricted
    and new.archived_at is not distinct from old.archived_at
    and new.archived_by is not distinct from old.archived_by
    and new.version is not distinct from old.version
    and new.updated_at is not distinct from old.updated_at
    and new.updated_by is not distinct from old.updated_by then
    return new;
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    v_action := 'resource.created';
  elsif old.archived_at is null and new.archived_at is not null then
    v_action := 'resource.archived';
  else
    v_action := 'resource.updated';
  end if;

  insert into public.activity_logs (
    workspace_id,
    actor_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    action,
    changes_json,
    metadata_json
  ) values (
    new.workspace_id,
    (select auth.uid()),
    'resource',
    new.id,
    v_action,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'title', new.title,
      'resource_type', new.resource_type,
      'category_id', new.category_id,
      'is_restricted', new.is_restricted,
      'version', new.version
    ),
    '{}'::jsonb
  );

  return new;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.resource_catalog_search_after_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_category_id uuid;
  v_resource_id uuid;
  v_resource_ids uuid[] := '{}'::uuid[];
begin
  if tg_table_name = 'resource_categories' then
    select coalesce(
      array_agg(resource.id order by resource.category_id nulls last, resource.id),
      '{}'::uuid[]
    )
    into v_resource_ids
      from public.resources resource
      where resource.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
        and resource.category_id = new.id;
  elsif tg_table_name = 'products' then
    select coalesce(
      array_agg(resource.id order by resource.category_id nulls last, resource.id),
      '{}'::uuid[]
    )
    into v_resource_ids
      from public.resource_products relation
      join public.resources resource
        on resource.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
        and resource.id = relation.resource_id
      where relation.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
        and relation.product_id = new.id;
  elsif tg_table_name = 'events' then
    select coalesce(
      array_agg(resource.id order by resource.category_id nulls last, resource.id),
      '{}'::uuid[]
    )
    into v_resource_ids
      from public.resource_events relation
      join public.resources resource
        on resource.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
        and resource.id = relation.resource_id
      where relation.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
        and relation.event_id = new.id;
  elsif tg_table_name = 'tags' then
    select coalesce(
      array_agg(resource.id order by resource.category_id nulls last, resource.id),
      '{}'::uuid[]
    )
    into v_resource_ids
      from public.resource_tags relation
      join public.resources resource
        on resource.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
        and resource.id = relation.resource_id
      where relation.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
        and relation.tag_id = new.id;
  elsif tg_table_name = 'tasks' then
    select coalesce(
      array_agg(resource.id order by resource.category_id nulls last, resource.id),
      '{}'::uuid[]
    )
    into v_resource_ids
      from public.resource_tasks relation
      join public.resources resource
        on resource.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
        and resource.id = relation.resource_id
      where relation.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
        and relation.task_id = new.id;
  end if;

  for v_category_id in
    select resource.category_id
    from public.resources resource
    where resource.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
      and resource.id = any(v_resource_ids)
      and resource.category_id is not null
    group by resource.category_id
    order by resource.category_id
  loop
    perform private.lock_resource_category_write(new.workspace_id, v_category_id);
  end loop;

  foreach v_resource_id in array v_resource_ids loop
    perform private.refresh_resource_search_vector(v_resource_id);
  end loop;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.resource_search_vector_v2(p_resource_id uuid, p_title text, p_description text, p_type resource_type, p_workspace_id uuid, p_category_id uuid)
 RETURNS tsvector
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    setweight(
      to_tsvector(
        'pg_catalog.portuguese'::regconfig,
        extensions.unaccent(coalesce(p_title, ''))
      ),
      'A'
    )
    || setweight(
      to_tsvector(
        'pg_catalog.portuguese'::regconfig,
        extensions.unaccent(
          concat_ws(
            ' ',
            coalesce(p_description, ''),
            coalesce((
              select category.name
              from public.resource_categories category
              where category.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
                and category.id = p_category_id
                and category.archived_at is null
            ), ''),
            coalesce((
              select string_agg(product.name, ' ' order by product.name)
              from public.resource_products relation
              join public.products product
                on product.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
                and product.id = relation.product_id
                and product.archived_at is null
              where relation.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
                and relation.resource_id = p_resource_id
            ), ''),
            coalesce((
              select string_agg(event.name, ' ' order by event.name)
              from public.resource_events relation
              join public.events event
                on event.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
                and event.id = relation.event_id
                and event.archived_at is null
              where relation.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
                and relation.resource_id = p_resource_id
            ), ''),
            coalesce((
              select string_agg(tag.name, ' ' order by tag.name)
              from public.resource_tags relation
              join public.tags tag
                on tag.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
                and tag.id = relation.tag_id
                and tag.archived_at is null
              where relation.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
                and relation.resource_id = p_resource_id
            ), '')
          )
        )
      ),
      'B'
    )
    || setweight(
      to_tsvector(
        'pg_catalog.portuguese'::regconfig,
        extensions.unaccent(coalesce((
          select string_agg(
            task.title || ' ' || workspace.task_prefix || '-' || lpad(task.task_number::text, 6, '0'),
            ' '
            order by task.task_number
          )
          from public.resource_tasks relation
          join public.tasks task
            on task.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
            and task.id = relation.task_id
            and task.archived_at is null
          join public.workspaces workspace on workspace.id = task.workspace_id
          where relation.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
            and relation.resource_id = p_resource_id
        ), ''))
      ),
      'C'
    )
    || setweight(
      to_tsvector('pg_catalog.simple'::regconfig, coalesce(p_type::text, '')),
      'C'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_task_special_lanes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_target_lane text;
  v_target_status uuid;
  v_old_lane text;
  v_old_status uuid;
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    select link.week_lane_key
    into v_target_lane
    from public.task_status_week_lane_links link
    where link.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
      and link.status_id = new.status_id
      and link.direction in ('both', 'status_to_week')
    limit 1;
    new.week_lane := coalesce(v_target_lane, new.week_lane);
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.status_id is distinct from old.status_id then
    select link.week_lane_key
    into v_target_lane
    from public.task_status_week_lane_links link
    where link.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
      and link.status_id = new.status_id
      and link.direction in ('both', 'status_to_week')
    limit 1;

    if v_target_lane is not null then
      new.week_lane := v_target_lane;
    else
      select link.week_lane_key
      into v_old_lane
      from public.task_status_week_lane_links link
      where link.workspace_id = old.workspace_id
        and link.status_id = old.status_id
        and link.direction in ('both', 'status_to_week')
      limit 1;
      if v_old_lane = old.week_lane then
        new.week_lane := case
          when new.due_date is null then 'backlog'
          else 'scheduled'
        end;
      end if;
    end if;
  elsif new.week_lane is distinct from old.week_lane then
    select link.status_id
    into v_target_status
    from public.task_status_week_lane_links link
    where link.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
      and link.week_lane_key = new.week_lane
      and link.direction in ('both', 'week_to_status')
    limit 1;

    if v_target_status is not null then
      new.status_id := v_target_status;
    else
      select link.status_id
      into v_old_status
      from public.task_status_week_lane_links link
      where link.workspace_id = old.workspace_id
        and link.week_lane_key = old.week_lane
        and link.direction in ('both', 'week_to_status')
      limit 1;
      if v_old_status = old.status_id then
        select status.id
        into v_target_status
        from public.task_statuses status
        where status.workspace_id = new.workspace_id
          and status.is_active
          and status.is_default
        order by status.position, status.id
        limit 1;
        new.status_id := coalesce(v_target_status, new.status_id);
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.task_collaboration_payload(p_task_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_checklists jsonb;
  v_comments_page jsonb;
  v_links jsonb;
begin
  select task.workspace_id into v_workspace_id
  from public.tasks task
  where task.id = p_task_id and task.archived_at is null;

  v_role := private.task_collaboration_role(p_task_id);
  if v_workspace_id is null or v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_TASK_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', checklist.id,
    'title', checklist.title,
    'is_default', checklist.is_default,
    'position', checklist.position,
    'created_by', checklist.created_by,
    'creator_name', checklist_creator.full_name,
    'created_at', checklist.created_at,
    'updated_at', checklist.updated_at,
    'items', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', item.id,
        'content', item.content,
        'position', item.position,
        'is_completed', item.is_completed,
        'completed_by', item.completed_by,
        'completed_by_name', item_completer.full_name,
        'completed_at', item.completed_at,
        'created_by', item.created_by,
        'creator_name', item_creator.full_name,
        'created_at', item.created_at,
        'updated_at', item.updated_at
      ) order by item.position, item.created_at, item.id), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.task_checklist_items item
      left join public.profiles item_creator on item_creator.id = item.created_by
      left join public.profiles item_completer on item_completer.id = item.completed_by
      where item.workspace_id = checklist.workspace_id
        and item.task_id = checklist.task_id
        and item.checklist_id = checklist.id
    )
  ) order by checklist.position, checklist.created_at, checklist.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_checklists
  from public.task_checklists checklist
  left join public.profiles checklist_creator on checklist_creator.id = checklist.created_by
  where checklist.workspace_id = v_workspace_id and checklist.task_id = p_task_id;

  v_comments_page := public.list_task_comments(p_task_id, null, null, 20);

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', link.id,
    'url', link.url,
    'label', link.label, 'description', link.description,
    'provider', link.provider,
    'created_by', link.created_by,
    'author_name', link_author.full_name,
    'created_at', link.created_at,
    'updated_at', link.updated_at,
    'can_edit_link', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager') or (v_role = 'member' and link.created_by = v_actor),
    'can_delete_link', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager') or (v_role = 'member' and link.created_by = v_actor)
  ) order by link.created_at, link.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_links
  from public.task_links link
  left join public.profiles link_author on link_author.id = link.created_by
  where link.workspace_id = v_workspace_id
    and link.task_id = p_task_id
    and link.deleted_at is null;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'checklists', v_checklists,
    'comments', v_comments_page -> 'comments',
    'comments_page', jsonb_build_object(
      'has_more', v_comments_page -> 'has_more',
      'next_cursor', v_comments_page -> 'next_cursor'
    ),
    'links', v_links
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.task_status_configuration_defaults()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    new.semantic_key := coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(new.semantic_key), ''),
      case
        when lower(btrim(new.name)) = 'emergência' then 'emergency'
        when lower(btrim(new.name)) = 'a fazer' then 'todo-default'
        when lower(btrim(new.name)) = 'em andamento' then 'in-progress'
        when lower(btrim(new.name)) in ('em revisão', 'alterações') then 'alterations'
        when lower(btrim(new.name)) = 'bloqueada' then 'blocked'
        when lower(btrim(new.name)) = 'concluída' then 'done'
        when lower(btrim(new.name)) = 'cancelada' then 'cancelled'
        else 'status-' || replace(new.id::text, '-', '')
      end
    );
    if new.icon_key is null or btrim(new.icon_key) in ('', 'circle') then
      new.icon_key := case new.semantic_key
        when 'emergency' then 'zap'
        when 'in-progress' then 'loader-circle'
        when 'alterations' then 'refresh-cw'
        when 'blocked' then 'shield-alert'
        when 'done' then 'circle-check'
        when 'cancelled' then 'circle-x'
        else 'circle'
      end;
    end if;
    new.version := 1;
  else
    new.semantic_key := old.semantic_key;
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and (
       new.name is distinct from old.name
     or new.color is distinct from old.color
     or new.cover_url is distinct from old.cover_url
     or new.icon_key is distinct from old.icon_key
     or new.position is distinct from old.position
     or new.is_active is distinct from old.is_active
     or new.is_default is distinct from old.is_default
  ) then
    new.version := old.version + 1;
  elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    new.version := old.version;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_product_operational(p_product_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_role public.workspace_role;
begin
  select * into v_product from public.products where id = p_product_id and archived_at is null;
  if not found then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  v_role := private.current_workspace_role(v_product.workspace_id);
  if auth.uid() is null or v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'PTA_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'product', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_product.id,
      'name', v_product.name,
      'status', v_product.status,
      'description', coalesce(v_product.description_json->>'text', ''),
      'owner_id', v_product.owner_id,
      'owner_name', (select full_name from public.profiles where id = v_product.owner_id),
      'version', v_product.version,
      'created_at', v_product.created_at,
      'updated_at', v_product.updated_at
    ),
    'events', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', event.id, 'name', event.name, 'status', event.status,
      'start_date', event.start_date, 'end_date', event.end_date,
      'owner_name', owner_profile.full_name
    ) order by event.start_date nulls last, event.name)
      from (select * from public.events where private.can_read_event(id)) event
      left join public.profiles owner_profile on owner_profile.id = event.owner_id
      where event.product_id = v_product.id and event.archived_at is null), '[]'::jsonb),
    'tasks', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', task.id, 'task_number', task.task_number, 'title', task.title,
      'priority', task.priority, 'due_date', task.due_date,
      'status_name', status.name, 'status_category', status.system_category,
      'assignee_name', assignee_profile.full_name
    ) order by task.updated_at desc)
      from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task
      join public.task_statuses status on status.id = task.status_id and status.workspace_id = task.workspace_id
      left join public.task_assignees assignee on assignee.task_id = task.id and assignee.workspace_id = task.workspace_id and assignee.is_primary
      left join public.profiles assignee_profile on assignee_profile.id = assignee.user_id
      where task.product_id = v_product.id and task.archived_at is null), '[]'::jsonb),
    'resources', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', resource.id, 'title', resource.title, 'type', resource.resource_type, 'updated_at', resource.updated_at
    ) order by resource.updated_at desc)
      from public.resource_products relation
      join public.resources resource on resource.id = relation.resource_id and resource.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id
      where relation.product_id = v_product.id and resource.archived_at is null and private.can_view_resource(resource.id)), '[]'::jsonb),
    'team', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', member.user_id, 'name', profile.full_name, 'role_label', member.role_label
    ) order by profile.full_name)
      from public.product_members member
      join public.profiles profile on profile.id = member.user_id
      where member.product_id = v_product.id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'history', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(log_row.item order by log_row.created_at desc)
      from (select log.created_at, jsonb_build_object(
        'id', log.id, 'action', log.action, 'actor_name', actor.full_name,
        'created_at', log.created_at
      ) item
      from public.activity_logs log
      left join public.profiles actor on actor.id = log.actor_id
      where log.workspace_id = v_product.workspace_id
        and (
          (log.entity_type = 'product' and log.entity_id = v_product.id)
          or (log.entity_type = 'event' and exists (
            select 1 from (select * from public.events where private.can_read_event(id)) related_event
            where related_event.id = log.entity_id and related_event.product_id = v_product.id
          ))
          or (log.entity_type = 'task' and exists (
            select 1 from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) related_task
            where related_task.id = log.entity_id and related_task.product_id = v_product.id
          ))
        )
      order by log.created_at desc limit 50) log_row), '[]'::jsonb),
    'capabilities', jsonb_build_object(
      'can_edit', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager'),
      'can_create_task', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'member')
    )
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_project_timeline(p_workspace_id uuid, p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_role public.workspace_role;
begin
  v_role := private.current_workspace_role(p_workspace_id);
  if auth.uid() is null or v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'PTA_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  if not exists (
    select 1 from (select * from public.events where private.can_read_event(id)) event
    where event.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
      and event.id = p_event_id
      and event.archived_at is null
  ) then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_EVENT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'phases', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', phase.id,
        'name', phase.name,
        'color', phase.color,
        'position', phase.position,
        'start_date', phase.start_date,
        'end_date', phase.end_date,
        'version', phase.version
      ) order by phase.position, phase.id)
      from public.event_phases phase
      where phase.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
        and phase.event_id = p_event_id
        and phase.archived_at is null
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'statuses', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', status.id,
        'name', status.name,
        'category', status.system_category,
        'color', status.color,
        'position', status.position
      ) order by status.position, status.id)
      from public.task_statuses status
      where status.workspace_id = p_workspace_id and status.is_active
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'tasks', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', task.id,
        'task_number', task.task_number,
        'title', task.title,
        'priority', task.priority,
        'status_id', task.status_id,
        'event_phase_id', task.event_phase_id,
        'start_date', task.start_date,
        'start_time', task.start_time,
        'due_date', task.due_date,
        'due_time', task.due_time,
        'version', task.version,
        'can_edit', private.can_edit_task(task.id),
        'assignee_id', assignee.user_id,
        'assignee_name', profile.full_name
      ) order by task.start_date nulls last, task.due_date nulls last, task.board_position, task.id)
      from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task
      left join public.task_assignees assignee
        on assignee.workspace_id = task.workspace_id
        and assignee.task_id = task.id
        and assignee.is_primary
      left join public.profiles profile on profile.id = assignee.user_id
      where task.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
        and task.event_id = p_event_id
        and task.archived_at is null
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'milestones', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', milestone.id,
        'title', milestone.title,
        'due_date', milestone.due_date,
        'event_phase_id', milestone.event_phase_id,
        'position', milestone.position,
        'completed_at', milestone.completed_at,
        'version', milestone.version
      ) order by milestone.due_date nulls last, milestone.position, milestone.id)
      from public.event_milestones milestone
      where milestone.workspace_id = p_workspace_id and milestone.event_id = p_event_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'capabilities', jsonb_build_object(
      'can_edit_tasks', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'member'),
      'can_manage_structure', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager')
    )
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_resource_detail(p_resource_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_resource public.resources%rowtype;
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if p_resource_id is null or not private.can_view_resource(p_resource_id) then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  select * into v_resource from public.resources where id = p_resource_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  v_role := private.current_workspace_role(v_resource.workspace_id);

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'resource', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_resource.id,
      'workspace_id', v_resource.workspace_id,
      'title', v_resource.title,
      'description', v_resource.description,
      'resource_type', v_resource.resource_type,
      'external_url', v_resource.external_url,
      'is_restricted', v_resource.is_restricted,
      'version', v_resource.version,
      'created_by', v_resource.created_by,
      'created_at', v_resource.created_at,
      'updated_at', v_resource.updated_at,
      'archived_at', v_resource.archived_at,
      'category', (
        select jsonb_build_object('id', rc.id, 'name', rc.name, 'color', rc.color)
        from public.resource_categories rc
        where rc.workspace_id = v_resource.workspace_id and rc.id = v_resource.category_id
      ),
      'is_favorite', exists (
        select 1 from public.resource_favorites favorite
        where favorite.workspace_id = v_resource.workspace_id
          and favorite.resource_id = v_resource.id
          and favorite.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      ),
      'last_visited_at', (
        select visit.last_visited_at from public.resource_visits visit
        where visit.workspace_id = v_resource.workspace_id
          and visit.resource_id = v_resource.id
          and visit.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      )
    ),
    'relations', jsonb_build_object(
      'tasks', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', task.id,
          'task_key', workspace.task_prefix || '-' || lpad(task.task_number::text, 6, '0'),
          'title', task.title
        ) order by task.task_number)
        from public.resource_tasks relation
        join (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task
          on task.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id and task.id = relation.task_id
        join public.workspaces workspace on workspace.id = task.workspace_id
        where relation.workspace_id = v_resource.workspace_id
          and relation.resource_id = v_resource.id
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'products', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', product.id, 'name', product.name) order by product.name)
        from public.resource_products relation
        join public.products product
          on product.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id and product.id = relation.product_id
        where relation.workspace_id = v_resource.workspace_id
          and relation.resource_id = v_resource.id
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'events', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', event.id, 'name', event.name) order by event.name)
        from public.resource_events relation
        join (select * from public.events where private.can_read_event(id)) event
          on event.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id and event.id = relation.event_id
        where relation.workspace_id = v_resource.workspace_id
          and relation.resource_id = v_resource.id
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'tags', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', tag.id, 'name', tag.name, 'color', tag.color) order by tag.name)
        from public.resource_tags relation
        join public.tags tag
          on tag.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id and tag.id = relation.tag_id
        where relation.workspace_id = v_resource.workspace_id
          and relation.resource_id = v_resource.id
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ),
    'permissions', case
      when v_role in ('owner'::public.workspace_role, 'admin'::public.workspace_role) then coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'user_id', permission.user_id,
          'full_name', profile.full_name,
          'permission', permission.permission
        ) order by profile.full_name)
        from public.resource_permissions permission
        join public.profiles profile on profile.id = permission.user_id
        where permission.workspace_id = v_resource.workspace_id
          and permission.resource_id = v_resource.id
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
      else '[]'::jsonb
    end,
    'capabilities', jsonb_build_object(
      'can_edit', private.can_edit_resource(v_resource.id),
      'can_manage_permissions', v_role in (
        'owner'::public.workspace_role,
        'admin'::public.workspace_role
      ),
      'can_archive', private.can_edit_resource(v_resource.id)
    )
  ) into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

declare

  v_week_version integer;

  if v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'PTA_WORKSPACE_FORBIDDEN';

  select setting.version into v_status_version

  select setting.version into v_week_version
  from public.task_board_settings setting
  where setting.workspace_id = p_workspace_id and setting.board_kind = 'week';

    'status_board', jsonb_build_object(
      'version', v_status_version,
      'columns', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(

          'key', status.semantic_key,
          'name', status.name,
          'category', status.system_category,
          'color', status.color,
          'icon_key', status.icon_key,
          'cover_url', status.cover_url,
          'position', status.position,
          'is_active', status.is_active,
          'version', status.version
        ) order by status.position, status.id)
        from public.task_statuses status
        where status.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ),
    'week_board', jsonb_build_object(
      'version', v_week_version,
      'columns', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'key', lane.lane_key,
          'name', lane.name,
          'color', lane.color,
          'icon_key', lane.icon_key,
          'cover_url', lane.cover_url,
          'position', lane.position,
          'is_active', lane.is_active,
          'is_system', lane.is_system,
          'version', lane.version
        ) order by lane.position, lane.lane_key)
        from public.task_week_lanes lane
        where lane.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ),
    'links', coalesce((

        'status_id', link.status_id,
        'week_lane_key', link.week_lane_key,
        'direction', link.direction,
        'version', link.version
      ) order by link.week_lane_key, link.status_id)
      from public.task_status_week_lane_links link
      where link.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_task_detail(p_task_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_task jsonb;
  v_activity jsonb;
  v_collaboration jsonb;
  v_custom_fields jsonb;
  v_subtasks jsonb;
  v_parent_task jsonb;
  v_can_edit boolean;
  v_can_collaborate boolean;
begin
  select task.workspace_id into v_workspace_id
  from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task
  where task.id = p_task_id and task.archived_at is null;

  if v_workspace_id is null or not private.is_active_workspace_member(v_workspace_id) then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_TASK_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  select to_jsonb(overview) || jsonb_build_object(
    'description_json', task.description_json,
    'requester_id', coalesce(task.requester_id, task.created_by),
    'requester_name', requester.full_name
  ) into v_task
  from (select * from public.v_task_overview where private.can_read_task(id)) overview
  join (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task on task.workspace_id = overview.workspace_id and task.id = overview.id
  left join public.profiles requester on requester.id = coalesce(task.requester_id, task.created_by)
  where overview.id = p_task_id;

  if v_task is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_TASK_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', field.id,
    'name', field.name,
    'type', field.field_type,
    'position', field.position,
    'version', field.version,
    'options', coalesce(options.items, '[]'::jsonb),
    'value', case field.field_type
      when 'text' then to_jsonb(value.text_value)
      when 'number' then to_jsonb(value.number_value)
      when 'date' then to_jsonb(value.date_value)
      when 'boolean' then to_jsonb(value.boolean_value)
      when 'single_select' then to_jsonb(value.option_id)
    end
  ) order by field.position, field.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_custom_fields
  from public.task_custom_field_definitions field
  left join public.task_custom_field_values value
    on value.workspace_id = field.workspace_id and value.field_id = field.id and value.task_id = p_task_id
  left join lateral (
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', option.id, 'label', option.label)
      order by option.position, option.id) as items
    from public.task_custom_field_options option
    where option.workspace_id = field.workspace_id
      and option.field_id = field.id
      and option.archived_at is null
  ) options on true
  where field.workspace_id = v_workspace_id and field.archived_at is null;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(child) order by relation.created_at, child.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_subtasks
  from public.task_subtasks relation
  join (select * from public.v_task_overview where private.can_read_task(id)) child
    on child.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id and child.id = relation.child_task_id
  where relation.workspace_id = v_workspace_id and relation.parent_task_id = p_task_id;

  select to_jsonb(parent)
  into v_parent_task
  from public.task_subtasks relation
  join (select * from public.v_task_overview where private.can_read_task(id)) parent
    on parent.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id and parent.id = relation.parent_task_id
  where relation.workspace_id = v_workspace_id and relation.child_task_id = p_task_id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', activity.id,
    'actor_id', activity.actor_id,
    'action', activity.action,
    'changes_json', activity.changes_json,
    'metadata_json', activity.metadata_json,
    'created_at', activity.created_at
  ) order by activity.created_at desc, activity.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_activity
  from (
    select id, actor_id, action, changes_json, metadata_json, created_at
    from public.activity_logs
    where workspace_id = v_workspace_id and entity_type = 'task' and entity_id = p_task_id
    order by created_at desc, id desc limit 50
  ) activity;

  v_role := private.task_collaboration_role(p_task_id);
  v_can_edit := private.can_edit_task(p_task_id);
  v_can_collaborate := v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'member');
  v_collaboration := private.task_collaboration_payload(p_task_id);

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'task', v_task,
    'activity', v_activity,
    'collaboration', v_collaboration,
    'custom_fields', v_custom_fields,
    'subtasks', v_subtasks,
    'parent_task', v_parent_task,
    'capabilities', jsonb_build_object(
      'can_edit', v_can_edit,
      'can_manage_assignees', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager'),
      'can_manage_custom_fields', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager'),
      'can_edit_custom_field_values', v_can_edit,
      'can_edit_description', v_can_edit,
      'can_manage_checklist_structure', v_can_edit,
      'can_toggle_checklist', v_can_collaborate,
      'can_comment', v_can_collaborate,
      'can_add_link', v_can_collaborate,
      'can_remove_any_link', v_role in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager'),
      'can_create_subtask', v_can_edit and v_can_collaborate,
      'can_manage_task_steps',
        to_regprocedure('public.remove_task_checklist_item(uuid,timestamp with time zone)') is not null
    )
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_events_operational(p_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_timezone text;
  v_today date;
begin
  v_role := private.current_workspace_role(p_workspace_id);
  if auth.uid() is null or v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'PTA_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select timezone into v_timezone from public.workspaces where id = p_workspace_id;
  v_today := (clock_timestamp() at time zone v_timezone)::date;

  with event_rows as (
    select
      event.*,
      product.name as product_name,
      owner_profile.full_name as owner_name,
      count(task.id) filter (where status.system_category <> 'cancelled')::integer as task_count,
      count(task.id) filter (where status.system_category = 'done')::integer as done_task_count,
      count(task.id) filter (where status.system_category not in ('done', 'cancelled'))::integer as open_task_count,
      count(task.id) filter (where status.system_category not in ('done', 'cancelled') and task.due_at < now())::integer as overdue_task_count,
      count(task.id) filter (where status.system_category = 'blocked')::integer as blocked_task_count,
      count(task.id) filter (where
        (status.system_category = 'blocked' and task.priority in ('high', 'urgent'))
        or (
          status.system_category not in ('done', 'cancelled')
          and task.due_at < now()
          and task.priority in ('high', 'urgent')
        )
      )::integer as critical_task_count
    from public.events event
    left join public.products product on product.id = event.product_id and product.workspace_id = event.workspace_id
    left join public.profiles owner_profile on owner_profile.id = event.owner_id
    left join (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task on task.event_id = event.id and task.workspace_id = event.workspace_id and task.archived_at is null
    left join public.task_statuses status on status.id = task.status_id and status.workspace_id = task.workspace_id
    where event.workspace_id = p_workspace_id and event.archived_at is null
      and private.can_read_event(event.id)
    group by event.id, product.name, owner_profile.full_name
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', row.id,
    'name', row.name,
    'status', row.status,
    'summary', row.summary,
    'product_id', row.product_id,
    'product_name', row.product_name,
    'owner_id', row.owner_id,
    'owner_name', row.owner_name,
    'start_date', row.start_date,
    'end_date', row.end_date,
    'version', row.version,
    'updated_at', row.updated_at,
    'task_count', row.task_count,
    'done_task_count', row.done_task_count,
    'open_task_count', row.open_task_count,
    'overdue_task_count', row.overdue_task_count,
    'progress', case when row.task_count = 0 then null else round(100.0 * row.done_task_count / row.task_count)::integer end,
    'health', private.event_health(
      row.health_override,
      row.start_date,
      row.end_date,
      case when row.task_count = 0 then 0 else round(100.0 * row.done_task_count / row.task_count)::integer end,
      row.overdue_task_count,
      row.critical_task_count,
      row.blocked_task_count,
      v_today
    ),
    'resource_count', (select count(*) from public.resource_events relation join public.resources resource on resource.id = relation.resource_id and resource.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id where relation.event_id = row.id and resource.archived_at is null and private.can_view_resource(resource.id)),
    'team_count', (select count(*) from public.event_members member where member.event_id = row.id),
    'milestone_count', (select count(*) from public.event_milestones milestone where milestone.event_id = row.id),
    'completed_milestone_count', (select count(*) from public.event_milestones milestone where milestone.event_id = row.id and milestone.completed_at is not null)
  ) order by row.start_date nulls last, row.name), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result
  from event_rows row;

  return jsonb_build_object('events', v_result, 'today', v_today);
end;
$function$

routines.arguments: p_workspace_id uuid
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_products_operational(p_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_timezone text;
  v_today date;
begin
  v_role := private.current_workspace_role(p_workspace_id);
  if auth.uid() is null or v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'PTA_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  select timezone into v_timezone from public.workspaces where id = p_workspace_id;
  v_today := (clock_timestamp() at time zone v_timezone)::date;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by item->>'updated_at' desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_result
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'id', product.id,
      'name', product.name,
      'status', product.status,
      'description', coalesce(product.description_json->>'text', ''),
      'owner_id', product.owner_id,
      'owner_name', owner_profile.full_name,
      'version', product.version,
      'updated_at', product.updated_at,
      'event_count', (select count(*) from (select * from public.events where private.can_read_event(id)) event where event.product_id = product.id and event.archived_at is null),
      'upcoming_event_count', (select count(*) from (select * from public.events where private.can_read_event(id)) event where event.product_id = product.id and event.archived_at is null and event.end_date >= v_today),
      'task_count', (select count(*) from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task join public.task_statuses status on status.id = task.status_id and status.workspace_id = task.workspace_id where task.product_id = product.id and task.archived_at is null and status.system_category <> 'cancelled'),
      'open_task_count', (select count(*) from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task join public.task_statuses status on status.id = task.status_id and status.workspace_id = task.workspace_id where task.product_id = product.id and task.archived_at is null and status.system_category not in ('done', 'cancelled')),
      'overdue_task_count', (select count(*) from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task join public.task_statuses status on status.id = task.status_id and status.workspace_id = task.workspace_id where task.product_id = product.id and task.archived_at is null and status.system_category not in ('done', 'cancelled') and task.due_at < now()),
      'resource_count', (select count(*) from public.resource_products relation join public.resources resource on resource.id = relation.resource_id and resource.workspace_id = relation.workspace_id where relation.product_id = product.id and resource.archived_at is null and private.can_view_resource(resource.id)),
      'team_count', (select count(*) from public.product_members member where member.product_id = product.id),
      'health', case
        when exists (select 1 from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task join public.task_statuses status on status.id = task.status_id and status.workspace_id = task.workspace_id where task.product_id = product.id and task.archived_at is null and status.system_category not in ('done', 'cancelled') and task.due_at < now() and task.priority in ('high', 'urgent')) then 'risk'
        when exists (select 1 from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task join public.task_statuses status on status.id = task.status_id and status.workspace_id = task.workspace_id where task.product_id = product.id and task.archived_at is null and status.system_category not in ('done', 'cancelled') and task.due_at < now()) then 'attention'
        else 'healthy'
      end
    ) as item
    from public.products product
    left join public.profiles owner_profile on owner_profile.id = product.owner_id
    where product.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
      and product.archived_at is null
  ) rows;

  return jsonb_build_object('products', v_result);
end;

routines.arguments: p_workspace_id uuid, p_query text, p_category_id uuid, p_resource_type resource_type, p_only_favorites boolean, p_only_recent boolean, p_include_archived boolean, p_limit integer, p_offset integer
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_resources(p_workspace_id uuid, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_resource_type resource_type DEFAULT NULL::resource_type, p_only_favorites boolean DEFAULT false, p_only_recent boolean DEFAULT false, p_include_archived boolean DEFAULT false, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(p_query), '');
  v_limit integer := coalesce(p_limit, 50);
  v_offset integer := coalesce(p_offset, 0);
  v_tsquery tsquery;
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  v_role := private.current_workspace_role(p_workspace_id);

  if p_workspace_id is null or v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  if v_limit < 1 or v_limit > 100 or v_offset < 0 then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'PTA_INVALID_RESOURCE_PAGINATION';
  end if;

  if v_query is not null then
    if char_length(v_query) < 2 or char_length(v_query) > 100 then
      raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'PTA_INVALID_SEARCH_QUERY';
    end if;
    v_tsquery := websearch_to_tsquery(
      'pg_catalog.portuguese'::regconfig,
      extensions.unaccent(v_query)
    );
  end if;

  with matching as (
    select
      r.*,
      rc.name as category_name,
      rc.color as category_color,
      exists (
        select 1 from public.resource_favorites favorite
        where favorite.workspace_id = r.workspace_id
          and favorite.resource_id = r.id
          and favorite.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      ) as is_favorite,
      visit.last_visited_at
    from public.resources r
    left join public.resource_categories rc
      on rc.workspace_id = r.workspace_id and rc.id = r.category_id
    left join public.resource_visits visit
      on visit.workspace_id = r.workspace_id
      and visit.resource_id = r.id
      and visit.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    where r.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
      and private.can_view_resource(r.id)
      and (
        r.archived_at is null
        or (
          p_include_archived
          and v_role in (
            'owner'::public.workspace_role,
            'admin'::public.workspace_role,
            'manager'::public.workspace_role
          )
        )
      )
      and (p_category_id is null or r.category_id = p_category_id)
      and (p_resource_type is null or r.resource_type = p_resource_type)
      and (
        not p_only_favorites
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.resource_favorites favorite
          where favorite.workspace_id = r.workspace_id
            and favorite.resource_id = r.id
            and favorite.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        )
      )
      and (not p_only_recent or visit.resource_id is not null)
      and (v_tsquery is null or r.search_vector @@ v_tsquery)
  ), filtered as (
    select * from matching
    order by
      case when p_only_recent then matching.last_visited_at end desc nulls last,
      matching.updated_at desc,
      matching.id desc
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', filtered.id,
          'workspace_id', filtered.workspace_id,
          'title', filtered.title,
          'description', filtered.description,
          'resource_type', filtered.resource_type,
          'external_url', filtered.external_url,
          'category', case when filtered.category_id is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
            'id', filtered.category_id,
            'name', filtered.category_name,
            'color', filtered.category_color
          ) end,
          'is_restricted', filtered.is_restricted,
          'is_favorite', filtered.is_favorite,
          'last_visited_at', filtered.last_visited_at,
          'version', filtered.version,
          'updated_at', filtered.updated_at,
          'archived_at', filtered.archived_at,
          'can_edit', private.can_edit_resource(filtered.id)
        ) order by
          case when p_only_recent then filtered.last_visited_at end desc nulls last,
          filtered.updated_at desc,
          filtered.id desc
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'total', (select count(*) from matching),
    'limit', v_limit,
    'offset', v_offset,
    'facets', jsonb_build_object(
      'categories', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', category.id,
            'name', category.name,
            'color', category.color
          ) order by category.position, category.name
        )
        from public.resource_categories category
        where category.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
          and category.archived_at is null
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'resource_types', to_jsonb(enum_range(null::public.resource_type))
    )
  )
  into v_result
  from filtered;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

routines.arguments: p_workspace_id uuid
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_task_activity(p_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(activity_id uuid, actor_id uuid, actor_name text, task_id uuid, action text, created_at timestamp with time zone, subject_user_id uuid, subject_name text, task_number bigint, task_title text, task_archived boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_workspace_id is null
    or not private.is_active_workspace_member(p_workspace_id) then
    raise exception using
      errcode = 'P0002',
      message = 'PTA_WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    al.id as activity_id,
    al.actor_id,
    actor_profile.full_name as actor_name,
    al.entity_id as task_id,
    al.action,
    al.created_at,
    metadata.subject_user_id,
    subject_profile.full_name as subject_name,
    coalesce(task.task_number, metadata.task_number) as task_number,
    task.title as task_title,
    task.archived_at is not null as task_archived
  from public.activity_logs al
  left join (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task
    on task.workspace_id = al.workspace_id
    and task.id = al.entity_id
  left join public.profiles actor_profile on actor_profile.id = al.actor_id
  left join lateral (
    select
      case
        when jsonb_typeof(al.metadata_json -> 'user_id') = 'string'
          and (al.metadata_json ->> 'user_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
        then (al.metadata_json ->> 'user_id')::uuid
        else null
      end as subject_user_id,
      case
        when jsonb_typeof(al.metadata_json -> 'task_number') = 'number'
          and (al.metadata_json ->> 'task_number') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
        then (al.metadata_json ->> 'task_number')::bigint
        else null
      end as task_number
  ) metadata on true
  left join public.profiles subject_profile
    on subject_profile.id = metadata.subject_user_id
  where al.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    and al.entity_type = 'task'
    and private.can_read_task(al.entity_id)
  order by al.created_at desc, al.id desc
  limit 50;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_task_attachments(p_task_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if not private.can_read_task(p_task_id) then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_TASK_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  v_role := private.task_collaboration_role(p_task_id);
  if p_task_id is null or v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_TASK_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'attachments', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', attachment.id,
          'object_path', attachment.object_path,
          'file_name', attachment.file_name, 'description', attachment.description, 'version', attachment.version,
          'file_extension', attachment.file_extension,
          'mime_type', attachment.mime_type,
          'file_size', attachment.file_size,
          'uploaded_by', attachment.uploaded_by,
          'author_name', author.full_name,
          'state', attachment.state,
          'created_at', attachment.created_at,
          'ready_at', attachment.ready_at,
          'can_remove',
            v_role in (
              'owner'::public.workspace_role,
              'admin'::public.workspace_role,
              'manager'::public.workspace_role
            )
            or (
              v_role = 'member'::public.workspace_role
              and attachment.uploaded_by = v_actor
            )
        ) order by attachment.created_at, attachment.id
      )
      from public.task_attachments attachment
      left join public.profiles author on author.id = attachment.uploaded_by
      where attachment.task_id = p_task_id
        and attachment.deleted_at is null
        and (
          attachment.state = 'ready'::public.task_attachment_state
          or attachment.uploaded_by = v_actor
          or attachment.delete_requested_by = v_actor
          or v_role in (
            'owner'::public.workspace_role,
            'admin'::public.workspace_role,
            'manager'::public.workspace_role
          )
        )
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'capabilities', jsonb_build_object(
      'can_upload_attachment', v_role in (
        'owner'::public.workspace_role,
        'admin'::public.workspace_role,
        'manager'::public.workspace_role,
        'member'::public.workspace_role
      )
    )
  ) into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

routines.arguments: p_task_id uuid, p_cursor_created_at timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_id uuid, p_limit integer
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_task_comments(p_task_id uuid, p_cursor_created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_limit integer := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 20));
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if (p_cursor_created_at is null) <> (p_cursor_id is null) then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'PTA_INVALID_COMMENT_CURSOR';
  end if;

  select task.workspace_id
  into v_workspace_id
  from (select * from public.tasks where private.can_read_task(id)) task
  where task.id = p_task_id
    and task.archived_at is null;

  v_role := private.task_collaboration_role(p_task_id);
  if v_workspace_id is null or v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_TASK_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;

  with page as (
    select
      task_comment.id,
      task_comment.parent_comment_id,
      task_comment.body,
      task_comment.created_by,
      comment_author.full_name as author_name,
      task_comment.created_at,
      task_comment.updated_at,
      task_comment.edited_at,
      task_comment.deleted_at,
      row_number() over (
        order by task_comment.created_at desc, task_comment.id desc
      ) as row_number
    from public.task_comments task_comment
    left join public.profiles comment_author
      on comment_author.id = task_comment.created_by
    where task_comment.workspace_id = v_workspace_id
      and task_comment.task_id = p_task_id
      and (
        p_cursor_created_at is null
        or (task_comment.created_at, task_comment.id)
          < (p_cursor_created_at, p_cursor_id)
      )
    order by task_comment.created_at desc, task_comment.id desc
    limit v_limit + 1
  ),
  visible as (
    select *
    from page
    where row_number <= v_limit
  ),
  last_visible as (
    select created_at, id
    from visible
    order by row_number desc
    limit 1
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'comments', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', comment_row.id,
            'parent_comment_id', comment_row.parent_comment_id,
            'body', comment_row.body,
            'created_by', comment_row.created_by,
            'author_name', comment_row.author_name,
            'created_at', comment_row.created_at,
            'updated_at', comment_row.updated_at,
            'edited_at', comment_row.edited_at,
            'is_deleted', comment_row.deleted_at is not null,
            'deleted_at', comment_row.deleted_at,
            'can_edit_comment',
              comment_row.deleted_at is null
              and comment_row.created_by = v_actor
              and v_role in (
                'owner'::public.workspace_role,
                'admin'::public.workspace_role,
                'manager'::public.workspace_role,
                'member'::public.workspace_role
              ),
            'can_delete_comment',
              comment_row.deleted_at is null
              and (
                v_role in (
                  'owner'::public.workspace_role,
                  'admin'::public.workspace_role,
                  'manager'::public.workspace_role
                )
                or (
                  v_role = 'member'::public.workspace_role
                  and comment_row.created_by = v_actor
                )
              )
          ) order by comment_row.row_number desc
        )
        from visible comment_row
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'has_more', (select count(*) > v_limit from page),
    'next_cursor', case
      when (select count(*) > v_limit from page) then (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'created_at', cursor_row.created_at,
          'id', cursor_row.id
        )
        from last_visible cursor_row
      )
      else null
    end
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

routines.arguments: p_workspace_id uuid
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_workspace_operating_model(p_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_role public.workspace_role;
  v_can_manage_all boolean;
  v_teams jsonb;
  v_functions jsonb;
  v_members jsonb;
begin
  if v_actor is null then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'PTA_AUTH_REQUIRED';
  end if;

  v_role := private.current_workspace_role(p_workspace_id);
  if v_role is null then
    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'PTA_WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_role = 'viewer'::public.workspace_role then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'PTA_TEAM_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;

  v_can_manage_all := private.can_manage_operating_model(p_workspace_id);

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', team.id,
        'name', team.name,
        'slug', team.slug,
        'description', team.description,
        'color', team.color,
        'is_default', team.is_default,
        'version', team.version,
        'created_at', team.created_at,
        'updated_at', team.updated_at,
        'member_count', (
          select count(*)
          from public.team_members counted_member
          where counted_member.workspace_id = team.workspace_id
            and counted_member.team_id = team.id
            and counted_member.removed_at is null
        ),
        'can_manage_members', (
          v_can_manage_all
          or private.current_team_role(team.id, v_actor) = 'lead'::public.team_member_role
        ),
        'members', (
          select coalesce(
            jsonb_agg(
              jsonb_build_object(
                'user_id', team_member.user_id,
                'full_name', profile.full_name,
                'initials', coalesce(
                  nullif(btrim(profile.initials), ''),
                  upper(left(btrim(profile.full_name), 1))
                ),
                'avatar_path', profile.avatar_path,
                'workspace_role', workspace_member.role,
                'team_role', team_member.role,
                'is_primary_team', team_member.is_primary,
                'version', team_member.version,
                'functions', (
                  select coalesce(
                    jsonb_agg(
                      jsonb_build_object(
                        'id', job_function.id,
                        'name', job_function.name,
                        'category', job_function.category,
                        'is_primary', member_function.is_primary,
                        'assignment_version', member_function.version
                      )
                      order by member_function.is_primary desc,
                        job_function.position,
                        lower(job_function.name),
                        job_function.id
                    ),
                    '[]'::jsonb
                  )
                  from public.team_member_functions member_function
                  join public.job_functions job_function
                    on job_function.workspace_id = member_function.workspace_id
                    and job_function.id = member_function.job_function_id
                    and job_function.archived_at is null
                  where member_function.workspace_id = team_member.workspace_id
                    and member_function.team_id = team_member.team_id
                    and member_function.user_id = team_member.user_id
                    and member_function.archived_at is null
                )
              )
              order by
                case team_member.role
                  when 'lead'::public.team_member_role then 0
                  else 1
                end,
                lower(profile.full_name),
                team_member.user_id
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
          )
          from public.team_members team_member
          join public.workspace_members workspace_member
            on workspace_member.workspace_id = team_member.workspace_id
            and workspace_member.user_id = team_member.user_id
            and workspace_member.status = 'active'::public.membership_status
            and workspace_member.removed_at is null
          join public.profiles profile
            on profile.id = team_member.user_id
            and profile.is_active
          where team_member.workspace_id = team.workspace_id
            and team_member.team_id = team.id
            and team_member.removed_at is null
            and (
              v_can_manage_all
              or team_member.user_id = v_actor
              or private.current_team_role(team.id, v_actor) = 'lead'::public.team_member_role
            )
        )
      )
      order by team.is_default desc, lower(team.name), team.id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_teams
  from public.teams team
  where team.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    and team.archived_at is null and private.can_read_team(team.id);

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', job_function.id,
        'system_key', job_function.system_key,
        'name', job_function.name,
        'category', job_function.category,
        'description', job_function.description,
        'position', job_function.position,
        'is_system', job_function.is_system,
        'version', job_function.version
      )
      order by job_function.position, lower(job_function.name), job_function.id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_functions
  from public.job_functions job_function
  where job_function.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    and job_function.archived_at is null;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'user_id', workspace_member.user_id,
        'full_name', profile.full_name,
        'initials', coalesce(
          nullif(btrim(profile.initials), ''),
          upper(left(btrim(profile.full_name), 1))
        ),
        'avatar_path', profile.avatar_path,
        'workspace_role', workspace_member.role,
        'workspace_member_version', workspace_member.version,
        'primary_team_id', (
          select team_member.team_id
          from public.team_members team_member
          where team_member.workspace_id = workspace_member.workspace_id
            and team_member.user_id = workspace_member.user_id
            and private.can_read_team(team_member.team_id) and team_member.is_primary
            and team_member.removed_at is null
          limit 1
        )
      )
      order by lower(profile.full_name), workspace_member.user_id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_members
  from public.workspace_members workspace_member
  join public.profiles profile
    on profile.id = workspace_member.user_id
    and profile.is_active
  where workspace_member.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    and workspace_member.status = 'active'::public.membership_status
    and workspace_member.removed_at is null
    and (
      v_can_manage_all
      or workspace_member.user_id = v_actor
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.team_members actor_team
        join public.team_members visible_team
          on visible_team.workspace_id = actor_team.workspace_id
          and visible_team.team_id = actor_team.team_id
          and visible_team.user_id = workspace_member.user_id
          and visible_team.removed_at is null
        where actor_team.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
          and actor_team.user_id = v_actor
          and actor_team.role = 'lead'::public.team_member_role
          and actor_team.removed_at is null
      )
    );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'workspace_id', p_workspace_id,
    'workspace_role', v_role,
    'teams', v_teams,
    'job_functions', v_functions,
    'members', v_members,
    'permissions', jsonb_build_object(
      'can_manage_teams', v_can_manage_all,
      'can_manage_job_functions', v_can_manage_all,
      'can_manage_all_team_members', v_can_manage_all
    )
  );
end;
$function$
